<function name="NavSetGoalPos" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Creates a path to closest node at given position. This won't actually force the NPC to move.

<note>This will call either <page>NPC:TaskComplete</page> or <page>NPC:TaskFail</page> for the current schedule and task, forcing the current task to progress to next task or fail. </note>

See also <page>NPC:NavSetRandomGoal</page>.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<added>2022.06.08</added>
	<args>
		<arg name="pos" type="Vector">The position to calculate a path to.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret type="boolean">Whether path generation was successful or not.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
